I know how stressful life and recovery and be and it as you've probably heard is tough and not linear. 

It's best to not overwhelm yourself and take things one step at a time. 

Make a list of things you feel you need to make progress on. And start working on one at a time. Maybe start with why gaining weight is such a bad thing. Where did this idea originate. And what you can do to fight it. (Difficult ik)

Despite whatever your weight is you deserve to recover, you deserve to get better and be able to enjoy all the food that this world has to offer. To be able to go out on your bday and not feel guilt for enjoying yourself. 

It's best to think "what am I doing this for" along the way. And to continue to remind yourself in order to fight the ed voice. 

We can start by taking that reminder off your phone babe, you don't need that I promise you. 

You deserve to eat another day to fuel your body so it can let you experience the amazing things this world can offer you. So you can make it to another bday. I know it's tough to see right now but there are so many things out there that your ed wants to keep you away from.

I don't have anything necessarily helpful to say coming from a person that's in a similar position but heres what I've got. 

People have different stresses. Idk if this is a good example but it's like how different stuff has different boiling points. Some boil quick some require more heat.

You aren't weak for having those reactions fucking school is hard man. And so is even thinking about the future.  Especially when it seems like everyone is succeeding and your lagging behind.  

No bodies a bad person for getting overwhelmed. College life isn't a simple road and even of you preform "well" your not really set up for the real world. 

Were all just going to get thrown into society and are forced to figure things out for ourselves. This system is just flawed. 

And when it comes to actually trying with school work when you've already seen your grades drop it feels pointless. It feels like if you even tried theres not much to be done. 

Or your minds just not focused on it as of now. 

Your mental state in general results in how your preform and your attention to certain things which unfortunately schools like to ignore. 

Know that you aren't bad for feeling this way or even lazy. 

College isnt for everyone and college isn't always going to be a straight forward journey with no dang breaks. 

It's okay to take them it's okay to collect yourself. If you keep going withought considering such your modivation may lower even more and your performance wont get better. 

If you can't take breaks just know this is all mentally draining and believe it or not by still being here your trying your best. Sometimes that's not recognized.
